Name: Eliel, Chief of Hebron
Summary: Chief of the sons of Hebron who brought up the ark, with his brethren fourscore.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 15:9; 1 Chronicles 15:11: Chief of the sons of Hebron who brought up the ark, with his brethren fourscore.
LifeLesson: The mention of Eliel in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
